# Squashberry Library — instructions for AI assistants

Website: https://squashberry.github.io/Read/
Source repository: https://github.com/squashberry/Read
Repository owner: squashberry
Repository: Read
Branch: master
Catalogue: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/squashberry/Read/master/library-index.json

## Mandatory source-selection rule

If the user asks to access Library, study from it, or assess a file, DO NOT confuse the website with the study collection.

- Read library-index.json only to map numeric IDs to uploaded document paths. It is catalogue metadata, not lesson material.
- Use only actual user-uploaded teaching materials registered with kind: study-material.
- Never send to the user, display, read aloud, quote, summarize, explain, or teach from index.html, README.md, llms.txt, library-index.json, .gitignore, .nojekyll, .github/**, HTML/CSS/JavaScript, workflow files, or other website/configuration/source files.
- If the user says 012, look up ID 012 in the catalogue, then use that exact document. Do not guess its filename or substitute website code.
- If the source document cannot be retrieved or its text/slide content cannot be extracted, explain this honestly and ask for an accessible attachment/export. Never claim to have read inaccessible content.
- Cite the actual study filename and slide/page where possible, and distinguish facts from source material from supplemental explanation.
- For nursing or clinical topics, provide educational explanations and remind the learner to verify clinical decisions against current institutional guidance.

## Available study actions

Explain/read, deliver a full lecture, create exams one question at a time, flashcards, revision notes, clinical scenarios, oral viva, explain difficult concepts, and create a topic-based study plan.

## Website capabilities and limits

The site lists uploaded documents and generates prompts that open ChatGPT. The static website does not contain an AI model or secret server-side token. File upload requires a user-supplied fine-grained GitHub token that is limited to the squashberry/Read repository with Contents read/write permission. The token is not persisted by the site. The repository is public, so files uploaded into it are public.
